name: TOB Seller Product
description: The local ledger of which edenza.org (WooCommerce) product id belongs to which student seller — the source of truth `marketplace/engine.py` uses for ownership checks, "my products" listing/pagination, and the low-stock scan, rather than depending on WCFM's own vendor-scoping (which WooCommerce's plain REST API does not expose). Cached display fields are refreshed on create/update/admin-approve and by the low-stock scan; they are a display convenience, not the source of truth for the live product itself (that's always edenza.org).

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Mirrors the WooCommerce product's real status — Pending means awaiting admin approval; Rejected is this app's own concept (WooCommerce has no such status; a rejected product is actually left in Draft on edenza.org).

fields.label: Low Stock Notified At
fields.description: Idempotency/cooldown guard for the low-stock scan — cleared once stock recovers above threshold so a future dip notifies again.

fields.label: Review Note
fields.description: Admin's reason when approving or rejecting this product — shown back to the student.
